mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (content, created_at, edit_deadline, last_modified_at, modify_count, first_weather, is_pinned, diary_date) VALUES (#{content}, #{createdAt}, #{editDeadline}, #{lastModifiedAt}, #{modifyCount}, #{firstWeather}, #{isPinned}, #{diaryDate})
mapper.select: SELECT diary_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diary WHERE YEAR(diary_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(diary_date) = #{month} GROUP BY diary_date
SELECT MONTH(diary_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diary WHERE YEAR(diary_date) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(diary_date)
